newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Colombo stocks end little changed.
newsitem.headline: Colombo stocks end little changed.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks ended on Monday little changed, brokers said.

The all share index closed 0.01 points lower at 621.89. Gainers outnumbered decliners by 24 to 15, but highly capitalised Commercial Bank Ltd fell five rupees to 140, pushing the index into negative territory.
Turnover, supported by foreign buying of nearly 250,000 shares of Lion Brewery Ltd, was 16.1 million rupees.
"Lion was an old foreign buy order which was put on hold, and reactivated after Hong Kong became fully operational," said Rohan Fernando a trader at brokerage CT Smith.
